sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Lucky Coin, Photo album, Field suture kit, Trail compass, Coat button. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 2). Gait tells story: walking (alternating), running (grouped), injured (drag marks). Count toes, measure stride.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Ghost Trail! You read tracks so well it's almost seeing the past. Hunt finds +25%. (Your knowledge of Reading Tracks amplifies your tracker.)
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 2). Predators test: they approach, watch, decide. Prey freezes or bolts. Learn which you're looking at.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 2). You can goad a statue into flinching.
📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 2). The ruse is perfect.
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.

🪤 Your old life comes back to your hands: the pit you dug before the Scattering — deep enough for a boar, staked at the bottom, brushed over with leaves and marked well. You never forgot the shape of it.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Gabriel Mikhailov. Hunting guide. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Unnamed photograph, Photo album, Knife roll, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
